text_block_list.name: Darley Arabian
text_block_list.text:
Welcome to Tracen Academy! We're delighted 
to meet all of you who hold such bright 
futures!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, marking a milestone in my time 
with <chrname>, I was tasked with guiding children 
on a trial school visit.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As part of the tour, I brought them to the 
VR Umalator to showcase the academy's 
latest training facility.

text_block_list.name: Child Horse Girl A
text_block_list.text:
Goddess ladies! Look, look! I saw you in a 
picture book before!

text_block_list.name: Child Horse Girl B
text_block_list.text:
Wait, they don't look like that at all! 
They look like big sisters!

text_block_list.name: Godolphin Barb
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, that's true. We aren't the real 
Three Goddesses, you see—we are AIs.

text_block_list.name: Byerley Turk
text_block_list.text:
Therefore, we shall answer any questions 
you may have. Is there anything you wish 
to ask us?

text_block_list.name: Child Horse Girl B
text_block_list.text: Umm, what should I ask!

text_block_list.name: Godolphin Barb
text_block_list.text:
You seem a bit shy, little one. Is there 
something you'd like to ask us?

text_block_list.name: Child Horse Girl C
text_block_list.text:
I'm... really not good at running at all. 
If I ask a question like this...

text_block_list.name: Darley Arabian
text_block_list.text:
...Alright, how about I show you some 
magic? Here goes!

text_block_list.name: Child Horse Girl C
text_block_list.text: Wah...!

text_block_list.name: Child Horse Girl A
text_block_list.text:
Amazing! So many flowers! They're so 
pretty!

text_block_list.name: Darley Arabian
text_block_list.text:
I'm glad you like them! And you know—these 
flowers represent you girls too.

text_block_list.name: Godolphin Barb
text_block_list.text:
You may only be small buds right now. Yet, 
one day, you will surely bloom in full 
glory.

text_block_list.name: Byerley Turk
text_block_list.text:
That you will one day bloom into a 
dazzling tapestry of countless vibrant 
flowers ...that is our wish.

text_block_list.name: Child Horse Girl C
text_block_list.text: We're... flowers...?

text_block_list.name: Child Horse Girl C
text_block_list.text:
U-Um! ...I always come in dead last in 
footraces. Even so, but—

text_block_list.name: Child Horse Girl C
text_block_list.text:
Can I become like you goddess ladies one 
day... Just like those pretty flowers...?!

text_block_list.name: Darley Arabian
text_block_list.text:
I see, you want to be like us! Well, you 
see...

text_block_list.name: Darley Arabian
text_block_list.text:
Of course you can! Because no one else 
gets to decide what your future will be!

text_block_list.name: Byerley Turk
text_block_list.text:
You wish to grow strong. As long as you 
hold that desire, we shall show you the 
way.

text_block_list.name: Godolphin Barb
text_block_list.text:
It may be a long and arduous path, but you 
will be fine. We will walk right alongside 
you.

text_block_list.name: Child Horse Girl C
text_block_list.text: ...! Y-Yeah! Then I'm gonna do my best!

text_block_list.name: Child Horse Girl A
text_block_list.text:
Me too! I wanna grow big like you big 
sisters and run a whole bunch!

text_block_list.name: Godolphin Barb
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, wonderful girls. Once you've grown 
up a little more, let us meet again in 
this very place, shall we?

text_block_list.name: Darley Arabian
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, sounds like a plan! ...We truly hope 
from the bottom of our hearts that we'll 
meet again someday.
